description:
What is This Part?
This is the Lower Steering Shaft & Rag Joint / U Joint Rebuild Kit w/ Steering Column Shell
NOTE: The lower steering shaft is a solid shaft.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Lower Steering Shaft
Qty 1 – Steering Flange and Bolt
Qty 1 – Steering U-Joint and Bolts
Qty 1 – Rag Joint
Qty 1 – Bolt/Nut/Washer Set for Rag Joint
Qty 4 – Spacers
Qty 2 – Plates for Rag Joint
INCLUDES: Steering Column Housing
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
